'''Darth Ouzal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], sometimes consulted by members of the [[Dark Council]] for his vast knowledge about [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]].

At some point during the war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Ouzal tried to duplicate the information contained in a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] into the [[Brain/Legends|brains]] of two [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war, [[Felix Iresso]] and [[Milo Pellam]]. Ouzal's experiment was a success, as Iresso had a [[Library/Legends|library]] of Sith knowledge locked in a corner of his brain, but Pellam became mad.
